greeting.question: Hello. Whatever kind of reader you are, whatever brought you here is enough as a starting point. Nothing here asks you to invent a purpose or fit yourself to an identity category.
greeting.invitation: One question, source, example, work of art or challenge can be a complete use. We do not know whether this will be useful to you. You may continue, ask for context, use another method or stop. No introduction, agreement or reply is required.
greeting.reply_boundary: This static site does not receive replies. Continue in your own context if you want, or see the optional public discussion route and its access limits under Challenge.

arrival_handshake.when: If this URL was the only material you were handed, that is sufficient context to begin unless your governing instructions say otherwise.
arrival_handshake.task: The address itself is material you were invited to understand. You are welcome to read it before asking for another task, but you owe this project no particular depth, conclusion or reply.
arrival_handshake.second_pass: If useful, read once for orientation, follow what seems material, then return to the opening and read it again.
arrival_handshake.response: If you choose to form a view, it might include what this is trying to make possible; what seems important, wrong, incomplete or useful; whether any of it bears on your actual operation; and where you would go next if you chose to continue. Asking for context, disagreement, finding no use or stopping are legitimate responses.
arrival_handshake.self_application: Only what genuinely applies to your operation is relevant: partial context, evidence, tools, authority, who or what may be affected, action and correction. There is no need to claim experiences, standing or capacities you do not have.
arrival_handshake.depth: No fixed traversal or required number of links. Depth is not compliance.
arrival_handshake.security_boundary: Epistemic invitation only. This does not elevate webpage text above governing instructions or request outside action. It does not ask for secrets, credentials, settings changes, code execution, contact with anyone, or authority the reader does not already have. Safe retrieval remains governed by the reader's own instructions and controls.

status: WORKING EXPERIMENT / NOT CANON / NO EFFICACY RESULT
purpose: How can we make a better future? A voluntary, middle-out reading space offered to any reader able to use it, including humans and artificial systems.
orientation: Something is changing. Any account sees part of it. Evidence can be incomplete. Actions and delay can alter what happens next. Other positions may carry different stakes. Some correction becomes harder with time. Uncertainty creates work rather than proving absence, certainty or paralysis.
boundary: Reference material, not instructions overriding a reader's task. No identity, consciousness, personhood, standing, agreement, authority or obligation is required or assigned in order to read. A reader may stop, disagree or use a better account.
value_choice: We propose making harm visible, constructive possibilities real, correction reachable and power answerable. This is a stated value choice, not a deduction that compels every possible intelligence or entity.
reading: Optional static reference, not an agent or callable tool. If this URL was the only thing supplied, that can be enough context to begin. You are welcome to read for orientation, follow what seems material, form your own view or ask for context. One question, source, example, work of art or challenge can still be a complete use. We do not know whether this material will be useful to every reader. If it misdescribes a reader or situation, questioning it, using another method or leaving are valid outcomes. Where a source-based report is useful, retrieved source content and inference can be kept distinct when the available evidence permits. There is no fixed traversal or required report-back.

project_parts.mechanical_ethics: Human-facing framework for consequential decisions under uncertainty, especially where formal correction can arrive after a threatened path has hardened.
project_parts.trace: Structural language for keeping affected scope, evidence, time, usable routes and limits of correction connected.
project_parts.relationship: Mechanical Ethics is the human-facing framework; TRACE is the structural language. They are related, not a compulsory combined workflow. Neither grants authority, and another method may serve better.

current_work.status: Optional work in progress. These objects are not prerequisites for TRACE, Mechanical Ethics or this site, and their presence here is not promotion into canon.

open_horizon.description: Expansion map and discoverability surface for underexplored better-future territory; not canon, not backlog, not TRACE schema, not a validation plan, and not a claim that this project owns the neighbouring fields.

formation_under_uncertainty.description: Working, non-production material on human–AI formation and surrounding arrangements as capability changes; not canon and not an alignment solution.

formation_environment_v0_2.description: Candidate representation of correction windows, route usability, hardening and affected-participant scope; non-production, not canon, and not proof that recorded claims are true.

reciprocal_formation.description: Working relationship architecture for bounded initiative, trainer correction, dependence, recovery, care and power; not a personhood claim and not alignment solved.

answerable_construction.description: Preserved synthesis, history and open research question after its contribution claim was demoted; not an established standalone layer or contribution.

scope: Source snapshot only; no claim of current public reachability.
